# Public ORCA Parse Fixtures

These small `.inp` files were downloaded from public repositories to exercise the
ORCA parser against real-world input shapes. They are test fixtures only; keep
them compact and prefer examples with explicit permissive licensing.

Retrieved: 2026-06-09

| Fixture | Source URL | Source license | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `butane_pes_scan.inp` | https://github.com/qclairvoyance/n-butane-pes-scans/blob/32099de246a67c5e0e86783590298e742829ed38/ORCA/orca_pes.inp | MIT, https://github.com/qclairvoyance/n-butane-pes-scans/blob/main/LICENSE | Internal-coordinate PES scan with `%output` and `%paras` blocks. |
| `benzene_geometry.inp` | https://github.com/kszenes/moltui/blob/fcee7dbfe11abc2bd99ca53afe6e5e951ecc92d3/data/geom/benzene.inp | MIT, https://github.com/kszenes/moltui/blob/master/LICENSE | Benzene optimization using lowercase method and basis tokens. |
| `water_optimization.inp` | https://github.com/lichman0405/chemvcs/blob/6b1c4472e86d1992428aa3c81e487762a71c775c/demo_orca/step1_opt/water.inp | MIT, https://github.com/lichman0405/chemvcs/blob/main/LICENSE | Water optimization with `%pal`, `%maxcore`, and `%geom` blocks. |
